sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic docs/theorem-index.md row requirements
sapience_notes.value: Every row on docs/theorem-index.md must be axiom-pinned in the C2 or C14 baseline pair inside scripts/check-module-invariants.sh (a heredoc of expected '#print axioms' lines plus a matching Lean heredoc). A plan that adds a theorem-index row must therefore list scripts/check-module-invariants.sh among its files and in the task's file_scope; a declaration reporting 'does not depend on any axioms' cannot be pinned and gets no row.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic PointedSound class design (milestone D4)
sapience_notes.value: Pointed soundness is stated once in FormalSystem/Metalogic/PointedSoundness.lean as a Prop-valued mixin class PointedSound L D over TruthEnv, with the derivation relation D : FrameClass -> List L -> L -> Sort u a parameter rather than a field, so a later object-level interface can require [PointedSound L D] of its own relation without two owners of the relation. The generic theorem is truth_of_derivation; its environment argument is explicit because the PUnit instances (TM, TM+) discard it and unification never assigns it (pass PUnit.unit, not the anonymous constructor).

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic star_soundness_in
sapience_notes.value: The context form of TM-star soundness goes through as plus_soundness_in arm for arm with the register environment v as one fixed binder shared by premises and conclusion; the induction generalizes the history and time only, and the three empty-context rules (necessitation, temporal necessitation, time reflection) need nothing new. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic full lake build cost
sapience_notes.value: On the 24-core host, a guarded full 'lake build' (default target FormalSystem, about 3010 jobs) after editing FormalSystem/Metalogic/Conservativity/Star/StarSoundness.lean took about 4 minutes wall; adding a leaf module under Metalogic and rebuilding took well under a minute. The default target excludes BimodalTest, so test modules need 'lake build BimodalTest' explicitly.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic check-module-invariants --emit-inventory side effects
sapience_notes.value: Adding a .lean file under FormalSystem/Metalogic/ makes --emit-inventory insert a README row with a '<!-- TODO: add description -->' placeholder that must be filled by hand, and line-count changes rewrite per-directory READMEs (e.g. Conservativity/Star/README.md, FormalSystem/README.md) beyond the top-level README.md and Metalogic/README.md.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh on Lean-only dispatches
sapience_notes.value: In BimodalLogic, verify-touched.sh maps no suite to Lean, docs or generated paths; with uncommitted specs plan files in the shared tree it falls back to a 119-suite agent-system battery (cost-class free) that did not finish within 400 seconds. For a Lean phase the repository's own checks are the usable scoped discharge.
